title: Final Prices With a Special Discount in a Shop
statement:
A shop displays `n` items in a row, and item `i` has price `prices[i]`. When you buy item `i`, you receive a discount equal to the price of the **first item to its right that costs less than or equal to** `prices[i]`: the item with the smallest index `j > i` such that `prices[j] <= prices[i]`. If there is no such item, you pay the full price.

The final price of item `i` is `prices[i]` minus its discount. Compute the **total** of the final prices of all `n` items.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer `n`.
The second line contains `n` integers `prices[0] ... prices[n - 1]`.
output_format: Print a single integer: the sum of the final prices of all items.

examples.explanation: Item 0 (8) gets the discount 4 from item 1, so it costs 4. Item 1 (4) gets 2 from item 3 (item 2 is 6, too expensive), so it costs 2. Item 2 (6) gets 2 from item 3, so it costs 4. Item 3 (2) has no cheaper-or-equal item to its right, so it costs 2. Item 4 is last and costs 3. Total 4 + 2 + 4 + 2 + 3 = 15.
Prices increase, so no item has a cheaper-or-equal item to its right. Nobody gets a discount and the total is 1 + 2 + 3.
Equal prices count: items 0, 1 and 2 each get a discount of 5 from the next item and cost 0. The last item costs 5.

hints: The brute force scans to the right for every item, which is O(n^2). Look for work that repeated scans share.
Process the items left to right and keep a stack of items that have not found their discount yet.
When a new price is less than or equal to the price on top of the stack, it is the discount for that item: pop it and apply the discount. Prices on the stack never decrease from bottom to top.
reference:
import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    p = [int(x) for x in data[1:1 + n]]
    total = sum(p)
    st = []
    for j in range(n):
        while st and p[st[-1]] >= p[j]:
            st.pop()
            total -= p[j]
        st.append(j)
    print(total)

main()

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(data[0])
p = [int(x) for x in data[1:1 + n]]
total = 0
for i in range(n):
    d = 0
    for j in range(i + 1, n):
        if p[j] <= p[i]:
            d = p[j]
            break
    total += p[i] - d
print(total)
